name: Maryland

filing.name: Maryland Department of Assessments and Taxation

labor.name: Maryland Department of Labor, Division of Unemployment Insurance

llcReport.title: File Annual Report and Personal Property Return

penalty.note: Initial penalty is 0.1% of county assessment or the statutory base amount, whichever is greater; 2% of the initial penalty accrues per 30 days late.

corpReport.title: File Annual Report and Personal Property Return

penalty.note: Initial penalty is 0.1% of county assessment or the statutory base amount, whichever is greater; 2% of the initial penalty accrues per 30 days late.

entityTax: Corporate income tax; optional pass-through entity tax

salesTax.permit: Maryland sales and use tax license

penalty.note: 10% of the tax due for a late return, plus interest; the collection discount is lost.

unemployment.note: $35 for each late report, plus 1.5% monthly interest on late payments.

newHire.note: $20 for failing to report newly hired or rehired employees after a warning notice (older state document; confirm with CSEA).

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Penalty of up to $25,000, paid to the Uninsured Employers' Fund (Labor & Employment 9-407, raised from $10,000 in 2024).

paidSickLeave.note: Maryland requires employers with 15 or more employees to provide paid earned safe and sick leave and employers with 14 or fewer to provide unpaid leave; smaller employers must still follow the tracking and notice rules.

local.title: County trader's license
local.description: Retailers and others selling goods need a trader's license from the county circuit court clerk; Baltimore and counties also require occupancy permits.

industry.alcohol: Maryland Alcohol, Tobacco and Cannabis Commission (with local boards)
industry.childCare: Maryland State Department of Education, Office of Child Care
